nodes.label: Peer-section parity: one emitter in a page directory makes every peer in it required, unless it is a reasoned exclusion
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset-seo/2026-09-28 - r3-r4-derived-breadcrumb-contract [ses_f16d0ca37ffeSEvQJQfzCLaHE2].md:L2617] A page directory becomes a "breadcrumb section" when at least one page in it emits `breadcrumbJsonLd=`. nodes.label: Portal identity derived from process cgroup
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t2-refuse-misattributed-session [ses_f1d1950eaffeY24JyhaeRpgIvu].md:L36] The portal derives identity from the process cgroup: for an unsandboxed host process it reads `sd_pid_get_user_unit(pid)` and matches a unit-name regex.

nodes.label: ashpd CreateSessionOptions exposes no app_id
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t2-refuse-misattributed-session [ses_f1d1950eaffeY24JyhaeRpgIvu].md:L35] `ashpd 0.13.13` `CreateSessionOptions` has only two `pub(crate)` token fields and no `app_id`; the portal frontend filters options to two keys.
